text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: billing-metering alert firing — token-counts deviating ~+12% vs baseline in eu-prod at 13:01 UTC. Paging @maria (oncall) and @jon-sre.

maria (oncall): ack — I'm on it, climbing in.

maria (oncall): quick check — correlated with emitter pod restarts? dashboard shows step-change at 13:01 UTC.

jon-sre: looking now. kafka consumer lag spiked ~13:00-13:02, possible duplicate replay. pulling emitter logs.

maya (billing-eng): seeing delayed ingest batches land around 13:10 and then a burst. Support reported 3 customers got provisional overage flags at ~13:15.

maria (oncall): which runbook do we follow for token-count drift? I'll start the billing-metric-reconciliation playbook (shadow-replay first).

jon-sre: quick grep to find dup emit ids:
```
# find duplicated emit ids
kubectl logs deploy/emitter -n prod | jq -r '.emit_id' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
```
I see ~2k repeats of same emit_id range. Looks like consumer committed failures then replayed.

maya (billing-eng): recommendation: pause writes to ledger to stop further bad writes — enable kill switch or feature-flag 'emit_to_ledger=false'. Any objections?

maria (oncall): good call. I'll toggle the flag slowly (zone-by-zone). @deploy-bot do feature-toggle emit_to_ledger=false prod.

deploy-bot: feature-toggle accepted. Rolling change to prod zones (6 zones) — progress: zone-1/6 applied.

maria (oncall): applied to zone-1/2. dashboards flattening, new duplicate writes stopped. backlog still draining from queue.

jon-sre: root cause hypothesis: autoscale + commit-latency caused ephemeral reprocessing. We'll add a consumer-side dedupe guard to prevent duplicate ledger writes.

maya (billing-eng): customers notified: support holds on issuing refunds until recon completes. sending standard template and monitoring.

maria (oncall): queued reconciliation job (shadow) and will run dedupe check. Estimated backlog drain by ~13:40 UTC.

maya (billing-eng): starting recon: `reconcile_tokens --from 2024-05-10T13:00Z --to 2024-05-10T13:25Z --dedupe --out /tmp/recon-1742519999.csv`

jon-sre: will open a short-lived hotfix PR to add idempotency guard in consumer (simple Redis seen set) and schedule canary.

maria (oncall): monitoring: counts trending back to baseline after flag toggle, overage flags being retracted in staging for affected accounts.

support-bot: Customer alert: 3 accounts received provisional overage emails at 13:15. Support holding escalation, awaiting recon results.

maria (oncall): incident owner assign -> @jon-sre for postmortem and long-term fix. I'll file short incident timeline and credits plan for affected customers.

maria (oncall): :thumbsup: closing active alert at 14:05 UTC — token counts stable, new writes stopped, overage flags retracted. Marking incident as resolved (P2).

incidents-bot: Incident resolved. Severity: P2. Runbook and timeline: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/1742519999
